name: AudioClip
signature: public sealed class AudioClip : Asset, ISerializable

docs.summary: Represents audio data that can be played back or streamed by an AudioSource. Supported file types are WAV/MP3/FlAC/OGG.
If the constructor with 'string filePath' overloaded is used this will contain the file path, or string.Empty otherwise.
The name of this AudioClip. If the filepath constructor is used it will contain the filepath, otherwise the string is empty.
If true, data will be streamed from disk. This is useful when a sound is longer than just a couple of seconds. If data is loaded from memory, this property has no effect.
If the constructor with 'byte[] data' overload is used this will contain a pointer to the allocated memory of the data. Do not manually free!
Gets the hash code used to identify the data of this AudioClip. Only applicable if the 'byte[] data' overload is used.
If the constructor with 'byte[] data' overload is used this will contain the size of the data in number of bytes.

members.name: AudioClip
members.signature: public AudioClip(string filePath, bool streamFromDisk = true)

docs.summary: Creates a new AudioClip instance which gets its data from a file on disk. The file must be in an encoded format.

params.filePath: The filepath of the encoded audio file (WAV/MP3/FLAC/OGG)
params.streamFromDisk: If true, streams data from disk rather than loading the entire file into memory for playback. Typically you'd stream from disk if a sound is more than just a couple of seconds long.

members.name: AudioClip
members.signature: public AudioClip(byte[] data, bool isUnique = false)

docs.summary: Creates a new AudioClip instance which gets its data from memory. The data must be in an encoded format.

params.data: Must be encoded audio data (either WAV/MP3/FLAC/OGG)
params.isUnique: Give this clip a buffer of its own instead of sharing one with every other clip holding the same bytes. Sharing is the default because it is what stops ten prefabs referencing one sound from holding ten copies of it, and nothing writes to the buffer once it is loaded.

docs.summary: Channel count of the decoded audio, 0 if it cannot be decoded.
Sample rate of the decoded audio in hertz, 0 if it cannot be decoded.
Length in sample frames. One frame holds one sample for each channel.
Length in seconds, 0 if the clip cannot be decoded.
Decodes the clip and returns its samples as interleaved 32 bit floats, one frame at a time across the channels. Returns an empty array if it cannot be decoded.
docs.remarks: This decodes on every call and hands back a fresh array, so it is for tooling and analysis (waveforms, beat detection, custom streaming), not something to call per frame.

members.name: Create
members.signature: public static AudioClip Create(string name, float[] samples, int channels, int sampleRate)

docs.summary: Builds a playable clip from raw interleaved samples, for procedurally generated audio.
docs.remarks: The samples are wrapped in a WAVE container, because playback decodes an encoded stream and bare PCM is not one. That keeps a procedural clip identical to an imported one everywhere else.

params.name: Name for the clip.
params.samples: Interleaved 32 bit float samples, one frame at a time across the channels.
params.channels: How many channels the samples are interleaved across.
params.sampleRate: Sample rate of the samples in hertz.

docs.summary: The encoded bytes this clip plays from, as they are stored. Empty for a file backed clip.

Frees native resources and anything derived from the payload. Runs when the asset unloads, before a refill and when a runtime asset is disposed. The database resets every field to its shell value afterwards.
Roughly how many bytes the loaded payload keeps alive, for the memory budget.
